name: TopSqill ITSM
install: npm ci --legacy-peer-deps && cd backend && npm ci && (npm run build || true)

terminals.name: frontend
terminals.description: Vite + React dev server for the TopSqill SPA on http://localhost:8080 (proxies /api to the backend).

terminals.name: backend-build
terminals.description: NestJS compiler in watch mode. Emits backend/dist on every change (tolerates the repo's pre-existing TS type-check warnings).

terminals.name: backend-run
terminals.command: cd backend && until [ -f dist/main.js ]; do sleep 1; done && node --watch dist/main.js
terminals.description: Runs the compiled NestJS API on http://localhost:3001/api and restarts when backend/dist changes. Requires the SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY secret.
